commitMessage:
Role-based permissions, 3-day installation test and billing review tools

- Roles (admin, reseller, customer) are read from the fields the server
  enforces; choosing a role sets and locks deviceReadonly, limitCommands
  and fixedEmail, and customer device/user limits. Admin can sync older
  accounts in one go from the Users page.
- Resellers no longer see delete buttons for users and devices, cannot
  change a device's IMEI, expiration or disabled state, and request
  activation/extension (copied message, WhatsApp when the support link is
  a wa.me link) instead of extending themselves.
- Every new device starts a 3-day installation test that locks itself;
  recording the first payment activates it. Countdown shows days and
  hours for the test and critical periods.
- Billing gets 'Perlu Diperiksa' (devices without expiration, test longer
  than 3 days, active longer than the last payment, no payment record,
  more than one customer) and 'Rekap Reseller' (per-device bill basis).
